div.ab: W[illelmus], Dei gratia rex Anglorum, R[adulfo] Bainardo et G[osfrido] de Magnavilla, P[etro] de Valoines ceterisque meis fidelibus de Essex et de Hertfordschire et de Middelsexe—salutem.
William, by the grace of God King of England, to Ralph Bainard and Geoffrey de Maundeville and Peter de Valognes and the rest of my loyal subjects in Essex, Hertfordshire and Middlesex—greeting.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 234–235 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added
